A still allows 'big numbers' in its top strip and says less about how to keep ordinary rows quiet; B's one flaw is that it promises five lanes but lists four. | pass 2 (A=with, B=without): Both answers turn the plain table into status lanes made of compact chips, keep every truck on screen, and respond directly to the hero-stat and big-card idea.
